title: Correct final ratio
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the ratio k must be exactly 3/5.

title: System acceleration analysis
description: Important: The student correctly determines the common acceleration of the three-block system using Newton's second law for the entire system (F - μ(6m)g = 6ma).

title: Free-body diagram for R
description: Important: The student applies Newton's second law to block R alone, relating the force F1, friction on R, and the common acceleration.

title: Free-body diagram for Q and R
description: Important: The student applies Newton's second law to the combined system of blocks Q and R, relating the force F2, total friction on Q&R, and their combined acceleration.

title: Algebraic solution
description: Important: The student correctly solves the system of equations to eliminate the unknowns F, μ, m, and a, isolating the ratio F1/F2.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student notes that the final ratio is dimensionless, confirming the analysis is dimensionally consistent.

title: Incorrect system isolation
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly applies Newton's second law by not using the correct combined masses when analyzing subsystems (e.g., using wrong mass for friction or inertia).

title: Sign error on friction
description: Pitfall: The student makes a sign mistake in the friction force terms within the equations of motion.
